subject: ela
cluster: Range of reading and level of text complexity

items.prompt:
Read the passage.

'Turtles have a hard shell to protect them. They pull their head and legs inside the shell when they are scared.'

What does a turtle do when it is scared?
items.answer: When a turtle is scared, it pulls its head and legs inside its shell.

steps: Read the second sentence: 'They pull their head and legs inside the shell when they are scared.'
The answer is directly stated.
A turtle pulls its head and legs inside the shell.

items.prompt:
Read the passage.

'Cows give us milk. Farmers milk cows every day. We use cow's milk to make cheese, butter, and ice cream.'

Name two foods made from cow's milk.
items.answer: Two foods made from cow's milk are cheese and butter (or ice cream).

steps: Read the last sentence: 'We use cow's milk to make cheese, butter, and ice cream.'
Three foods are listed: cheese, butter, ice cream.
Name any two: cheese and butter, cheese and ice cream, or butter and ice cream.

items.prompt:
Read the passage.

'To make a paper airplane, fold a piece of paper in half the long way. Then fold the top corners down to meet the center line. Fold the paper in half again and fold down the wings. Throw it and watch it fly!'

What type of text is this?
items.answer: This is a how-to text (procedural text) because it gives step-by-step instructions for making a paper airplane.

steps: The text gives steps for making something.
Words like 'then,' 'again,' and 'fold' signal steps.
A text that tells you how to do or make something is a how-to text.
This is a how-to text.

items.prompt:
Read the passage.

'Dolphins are very intelligent. They live in groups called pods and take care of each other. Dolphins have been known to help injured dolphins stay at the surface so they can breathe.'

What does the passage suggest about dolphins' personalities? Use evidence.
items.answer: The passage suggests that dolphins are caring and social animals. Evidence: they live in groups and take care of each other, and they have been known to help injured dolphins breathe by supporting them at the surface.

steps: The passage calls dolphins 'intelligent' and describes caring behaviors.
Evidence 1: they live in pods and take care of each other.
Evidence 2: they help injured dolphins stay at the surface.
Helping injured group members suggests empathy and social care.
Inferred personality: caring, social, protective.

items.prompt:
Read the passage.

'You should drink eight glasses of water every day. Water helps every cell in your body work properly. It also flushes out waste and keeps your skin healthy. Staying hydrated can even improve your mood.'

Is this a persuasive text or an informational text? Give one clue from the text.
items.answer: This is a persuasive text. The clue is the first sentence: 'You should drink eight glasses of water every day.' The word 'should' tells you the author is recommending an action, not just sharing information.

steps: Read the first sentence: 'You should drink...'
'Should' is a recommendation word.
Persuasive texts recommend or instruct; informational texts describe or explain.
The author wants you to drink more water, which is a persuasive goal.
The rest of the text provides reasons to support the recommendation.

items.prompt:
Read the passage.

'Frederick Douglass was born into slavery in 1818. He secretly learned to read and write. After escaping slavery, he became a famous speaker and writer who argued that all people deserved to be free.'

What is most impressive about Frederick Douglass based on this passage?
items.answer: The most impressive thing is that despite being born into slavery and not being allowed to learn, Douglass secretly taught himself to read and write, then escaped and became a famous speaker who fought for freedom.

steps: List what Douglass overcame: born into slavery, secretly had to learn to read.
What he achieved: escaped, became a famous speaker and writer.
Most impressive: learning to read despite it being forbidden, then using that skill for freedom.
The passage moves from hardship to achievement, showing the contrast.

items.prompt:
Read the passage.

'Venus is the hottest planet in our solar system, even though Mercury is closer to the sun. Venus has a thick atmosphere full of carbon dioxide that traps heat, like a blanket around the planet. This process is called the greenhouse effect.'

What seems surprising in this passage? How does the passage explain the surprise?
items.answer: The surprising fact is that Venus is hotter than Mercury, even though Mercury is closer to the sun. The passage explains this by describing the greenhouse effect: Venus has a thick atmosphere of carbon dioxide that traps heat like a blanket. This trapped heat makes Venus hotter than Mercury even from farther away.

steps: Surprising fact: Venus is hottest, but Mercury is closer to the sun.
Normally: closer to the sun = hotter. Mercury should be hottest.
Explanation: Venus has a thick carbon dioxide atmosphere.
This atmosphere traps heat (the greenhouse effect).
Trapped heat builds up, making Venus hotter despite being farther from the sun.
The passage uses the surprise to teach about the greenhouse effect.

items.prompt:
Read the passage.

'To plant a seed, dig a small hole, place the seed inside, and cover it with soil. Water the soil and place it in a sunny spot. Soon you will see a tiny green sprout push up through the dirt.'

This is a how-to text. Name two features that make it a how-to text. Then explain: why does the last sentence not fit the typical how-to format, and why might the author have included it?
items.answer: Two features: (1) it gives step-by-step instructions in sequence (dig, place, cover, water), and (2) it tells you the materials and conditions needed (soil, sunny spot). The last sentence ('Soon you will see a tiny green sprout...') is not an instruction; it is a description of the outcome. The author included it to motivate the reader by showing what the result will look like, making the task feel rewarding.

steps: Feature 1: step-by-step instructions (dig, place, cover, water, place in sun).
Feature 2: conditions needed (sunny spot, soil).
Last sentence: 'Soon you will see a tiny green sprout...'
Is this an instruction? No. It describes the result.
How-to texts typically only give steps, not describe what happens afterward.
Why included? To show the reader the reward for following the steps.
Describing the outcome motivates readers to try the task.
